Komorów  is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Kampinos, within Warsaw West County, Masovian Voivodeship, in east-central Poland. It lies approximately  west of Kampinos,  west of Ożarów Mazowiecki (the county seat), and  west of Warsaw.
